name: wormhole-ovpn-shim
description: Transitive C++ dependencies for the Wormhole OpenVPN sidecar shim. mbedtls is vendored as a submodule (see ../third_party/mbedtls) so it isn't listed here. tap-windows6 is included for its <tap-windows.h> HEADER ONLY — OpenVPN3's cliopt.hpp / tunutil.hpp include the header unconditionally on Windows, but our runtime path uses ExternalTun::Factory so the TAP driver is never installed or loaded.
